An Unsecured Kafka Server Broadcast Admin Tokens for at Least 100 Days

In this issue

  • The Silence on One Side. Cybernews contacted Omegatheme and Shopify both.
  • Two More Apps, Same Shape. The 888 leak wasn't the only third-party exposure on Shopify's app layer.
  • Who Owns the Risk. On September 4, 2026, Sansec disclosed StyleSmuggler, an unauthenticated remote-code-execution zero-day sitting inside Magento and Adobe Commerce.
  • What to Check in Your App List. A badge and a star rating tell you an app looks trustworthy to other merchants and to Shopify's own review process.
